name: Chalet Hotels Ltd
title: Chalet Hotels Ltd - 542399 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 RevPAR fell 3% on a 7.7pt occupancy drop, mostly Mumbai and West Asia cancellations (~10-12% disruption per management); FY27-29 capex ~INR30bn guided, funded from accruals, with no supply discipline signal.

utilisation.quote: RevPAR declined 3% year -on-year in quarter 4, largely driven by a 7.7 percentage point drop in occupancy.

capex.quote: we have outlined a planned capex of approximately INR30 billion over FY '27 to FY '29

triggers.label: Q4 RevPAR -3%, occupancy -7.7pts
triggers.quote: RevPAR declined 3% year -on-year in quarter 4, largely driven by a 7.7 percentage point drop in occupancy.

triggers.label: Disruption ~10-12% from West Asia
triggers.quote: the political tensions have caused about a 10% to 12% disruption in our business.

triggers.label: April stronger, May strong per mgmt
triggers.quote: April has been stronger and actually has surprised us also on a year -on-year trend. And May is really strong.

triggers.label: Net debt INR25bn to ~INR19bn
triggers.quote: net debt has reduced from INR25 billion as of March '24 to approximately INR19 billion as of March '26.

guidance.quote: we have outlined a planned capex of approximately INR30 billion over FY '27 to FY '29

guidance.value: scale to INR300 million during FY27
guidance.quote: We expect monthly rentals to scale up to INR300 million during FY '27.

guidance.value: Strong recovery expected in second half of year
guidance.quote: we expect a strong recovery and bounce back in the second half of the year, broadly speaking.

red_flags.label: Hospitality margin down 81bps FY; Q4 -102bps
red_flags.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 47.4%, lower by 102 basis points.

red_flags.label: Unannounced DIAL minority dilution at project level
red_flags.quote: the Board has approved a onetime proposal for a minority equity shareholding in just one of our projects.

evasions.topic: Peak debt and FY27 ADR outlook
evasions.quote: No, not really. We continue to believe in the strength of the business.
Nitin Khanna: Karan, from a direction perspective, I think we normally don't give future directions in a very specific property.
we are not able to share the project timelines, capex and brand-related information at this stage.
